gate.title: Can you read this?
gate.sub: No pressure — this just picks the right first step.
gate.noHint: Start with Hangul — no test needed

result.title: Your seed is planted
result.suggested: Your answers point to {level}. Tap another level if it feels off.
result.pickHint: Starting at A1. Already know some Korean? Tap your level.

signup.title: Keep your spot
signup.googleFast: Fastest — no email to wait for
signup.agree: I agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
signup.seedBubble: I'll wait right here — keep me?

confirm.title: Enter your code
confirm.sub: We emailed an 8-digit code to {email}. Type it below — just this once. After that, your password is all you need.
confirm.sentAgain: Sent again — give it a minute.

saving.title: Planting your seed…
saving.sub: Saving {level} and opening your first lesson.
saving.failedSub: Your connection dropped just as we were planting. Your level is safe — try again.

errors.authFailed: That didn't work. Request a new code and try again.
errors.rateLimit: Sorry — we've hit tonight's hourly email limit while we're still testing. Please try again in about an hour, or continue with Google instead.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.badCode: That code didn't work. Check it, or tap Resend for a new one.
errors.exists: That email already has an account — log in instead.
errors.badEmail: That doesn't look like an email address. Check it and try again.
errors.tooSoon: A code was just sent to that address. Wait a minute before asking for another.
errors.tooManyTries: Too many wrong codes. Tap Resend to get a fresh one and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
errors.notConfirmed: This email isn't confirmed yet. Enter the code we sent, or tap Resend.
errors.badCredentials: That email and password don't match. One more try, or reset your password from the login page.
errors.noAccount: We couldn't find an account for that email.

intro.greeting: Hi! I'm a seed. Want to write one Hangul letter with me?
intro.stroke1: Stroke 1 · from the top down to the left
intro.stroke2: Stroke 2 · from the middle down to the right
intro.traceDone: Nice! The seed is waking up…
intro.cantRead: I can't read Hangul yet — start with Hangul
intro.sproutNote: Sign-up comes last · the sprout 🌱 arrives at Lv.3

survey.changeLater: Not sure? Pick your best guess — you can change it any time in Settings.

reading.title: Which sounds like you when you read Korean?
reading.A2: I can read short signs and menus
reading.B1: I can read simple messages and short stories
reading.B2: I can follow webtoons and blog posts
reading.C2: I read books and reports with ease

listening.title: And when you listen?
listening.A1: Only a few words I already know
listening.A2: Slow, simple phrases like greetings and prices
listening.B1: Everyday talk, if it's slow and clear
listening.C1: Dramas and variety shows, mostly without subtitles
listening.C2: Almost anything, even fast casual speech

speaking.title: And when you speak?
speaking.A2: I can introduce myself and order food
speaking.B1: I can talk about my day and my plans
speaking.B2: I can hold a conversation with a friend
speaking.C1: I can discuss news and opinions
speaking.C2: I can work or study in Korean
